capabilities.name: Book a doctor's appointment
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent find a free slot with a doctor and book it for you?

US.note: Since August 2026 Zocdoc is a connected app in Google Gemini for US users aged 18 and over: you say what care you need, see real open slots, and book an in-person or video visit without leaving Gemini.

evidence.title: Now you can connect even more of your favorite apps and services to Gemini (book a doctor's appointment with Zocdoc)
Check the availability and requirements of connected apps in Gemini Apps
Zocdoc and Google Bring Real-Time Healthcare Appointment Booking to Gemini

GB.note: Rapid Health's Smart Triage inside the NHS App asks about your symptoms and books a GP slot straight away, but only at the practices that use it (over 1 million patients in April 2026), not across the NHS.

evidence.title: 24/7 GP appointment booking is now live in the NHS App for more than one million patients
FAQs (book your appointment through Smart Triage)

DE.note: Doctolib's AI phone assistant takes patient calls at any hour and books straight into the practice calendar, but only at practices that pay for it, with no public count; Doctolib has no patient-side booking agent, and no AI booking was found on the public 116117 service.

evidence.title: Doctolib führt KI-basierten Telefonassistenten ein

IN.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found: Practo, Apollo 24|7, Tata 1mg and Eka Care book through ordinary apps, and only vendor marketing and an old Apollo Alexa skill turned up (searched October 2026).

BR.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found: no Doctoralia booking agent has launched here, and the SUS WhatsApp pilot only confirms or moves visits, with no AI named.

evidence.title: SUS ganha marcação de consultas pelo WhatsApp; como vai funcionar e quando começa?

MX.note: IMSS appointments go through the IMSS Digital app, the website or the phone, and its first AI assistant is planned for doctors, not patients. No Doctoralia booking agent was found here.

evidence.title: El IMSS planea aplicar inteligencia artificial en su expediente clínico electrónico

CL.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found at FONASA, Hospital Digital or Doctoralia (searched October 2026).

CO.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found at the EPS insurers or Doctoralia; EPS Sanitas's WhatsApp assistant books visits, but no source says it is AI (searched October 2026).

ES.note: Docplanner, Doctoralia's parent, said in March 2026 that it plans to bring Noa Booking, its AI phone agent that takes patient calls at any hour and books appointments, to Spain; we found no Spanish launch yet. Patients still book on Doctoralia themselves, and Gemini's Zocdoc booking is US-only.

evidence.title: Docplanner expands patient access with voice AI agent powered by Twilio (plans to expand Noa Booking to Spain)
Check the availability and requirements of connected apps in Gemini Apps

FR.note: Doctolib's AI phone assistant answers patient calls at any hour and writes the appointment straight into the practice calendar, starting with GPs and dentists that pay for it, with other specialties due by the end of 2026. We found no patient-side booking agent from Doctolib in production.

evidence.title: Fini les appels sans réponse chez le médecin grâce à l'assistant intelligent de Doctolib

CA.note: In Ontario a 40-clinic pilot led by Amplify Care and Strello Health tests virtual agents that triage patients and book visits (December 2025); we could not confirm how far it books on its own. Gemini's Zocdoc booking is US only.

evidence.title: Appointment booking AI triage pilot launches in Ontario
Check the availability and requirements of connected apps in Gemini Apps

JP.note: Some hospitals and clinics use AI phone lines that take booking requests: the National Cancer Center Hospital's AI phone takes first-visit requests 24 hours a day, but staff then pick the date and reply by SMS, and it needs a referral letter. We found no patient-side agent that books a doctor, and Zocdoc in Gemini is US-only.

evidence.title: 初診予約専用AI電話
evidence.publisher: National Cancer Center Hospital (国立がん研究センター中央病院)

evidence.title: Check the availability and requirements of connected apps in Gemini Apps

AU.note: Healthengine's Helen AI receptionist answers calls and books, moves or cancels appointments straight into the practice system, but only at practices that use Best Practice or Pracsoft and pay for it. No patient-side booking agent was found, and Gemini's Zocdoc booking is US-only.

evidence.title: Voice AI receptionist (Helen AI)
Check the availability and requirements of connected apps in Gemini Apps

NG.note: No AI agent that books a doctor was found. BetaCare's WhatsApp chatbot books virtual consultations and AXA Mansard Health's WhatsApp bot Karis finds partner hospitals, but no source says either is AI or books in-person slots; Gemini's Zocdoc booking is US-only.

evidence.title: Karis: AXA Mansard Health's WhatsApp chatbot to reduce waiting time at hospital

KR.note: Hallym University Kangnam Sacred Heart Hospital's CareChat, inside KakaoTalk, books, changes and cancels appointments, and it opened in July 2025. That is one hospital's service, and I found no agent that books a doctor across hospitals for you.

evidence.title: 비대면 원스톱 서비스 '케어챗' 오픈

SG.note: HealthHub's Appointments service needs a Singpass login and is a normal online booking form. We found no AI agent that books a doctor slot in Singapore.

evidence.title: HealthHub

ID.note: Halodoc's AI assistant, AIDA, is built to help doctors, not patients, and we found no AI agent that books a doctor for patients in Indonesia. Patients still book through apps such as Halodoc and Alodokter.

evidence.title: Halodoc perkenalkan AIDA, AI Doctor Assistant untuk memberdayakan layanan kesehatan dan dokter Indonesia

capabilities.name: Renew or order a prescription
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent renew or order your prescription medicine for you?

US.note: Amazon's Health AI, in the One Medical app and since March 2026 on Amazon.com, sends your renewal request to a One Medical provider and the medicine is filled at Amazon Pharmacy or another pharmacy; in a one-year Utah pilot, Doctronic's AI renews some chronic-condition prescriptions on its own.

evidence.title: Amazon's Health AI agent (One Medical)
Utah is experimenting with a new role for AI: renewing prescriptions

GB.note: You can order repeat prescriptions in the NHS App, but no AI agent can do it for you, and no Boots agent was found.

evidence.title: Prescriptions in the NHS App

DE.note: E-prescriptions (e-Rezept) are redeemed with the health card, the gematik app or a printout, with no route for an agent; no AI ordering was found at DocMorris or Shop Apotheke.

evidence.title: E-Rezept

IN.note: PharmEasy's AI voice agent calls past buyers to remind them to reorder and sends a WhatsApp link, but you finish the order yourself; no AI ordering was found at Apollo 24|7, Tata 1mg or Netmeds.

evidence.title: How PharmEasy Improved Medicine Reorder Conversion with Ringg

BR.note: RD Saúde (Drogasil and Raia) runs AI agents mostly for staff and call centres, and lists a pharmacist agent only as a future idea; no agent that orders prescription medicine was found.

evidence.title: RD Saúde e IA agêntica

MX.note: Farmacias del Ahorro uses Gemini Enterprise mainly for staff work, and nothing was found at Farmacias Guadalajara; no agent that orders prescription medicine was found.

evidence.title: Farmacias del Ahorro se sube a la ola de la IA y busca ahorrar 100,000 horas de trabajo al año

CL.note: No AI ordering was found at Cruz Verde, Salcobrand or Farmacias Ahumada; Recemed's WhatsApp assistant lets doctors write e-prescriptions, but patients cannot order through it.

evidence.title: Recetas médicas electrónicas disponibles por WhatsApp

CO.note: No AI agent that orders prescription medicine was found at Cruz Verde Colombia or other chains (searched October 2026).

ES.note: Spain's electronic prescription is dispensed at the pharmacy with the health card, and we found no AI agent that renews or orders prescription medicine for you.

FR.note: No AI agent renews or orders prescription medicine in France. Renewal needs a doctor (often by teleconsultation, such as Qare or Medadom) or, in limited cases, a pharmacist, and only a pharmacist may dispense.

evidence.title: Renouvellement d'ordonnance : comment ça marche ?
Renouvellement d'ordonnance

CA.note: No AI agent that renews or orders prescriptions was found at Shoppers Drug Mart, Rexall or PocketPills; pharmacy AI tools found are for staff, not patients.

JP.note: We found no AI agent that renews or orders prescription medicine in Japan; renewals need a doctor's visit, in person or online, and Amazon's Health AI renewals are US-only.

AU.note: We found no AI agent that renews or orders prescription medicine in Australia. We did not search pharmacy chains one by one.

NG.note: No AI agent that renews or orders prescription medicine was found. Sproxil's AISHA on WhatsApp only gives health information after you check a medicine is genuine.

evidence.title: Trust in Your Hands: Sproxil's AISHA Assistant Boosts Confidence in Nigeria's Healthcare System

KR.note: A Medical Act amendment due to take effect on December 24 allows prescription medicine delivery only to island and remote residents, vulnerable groups, and people with infectious or rare diseases. The government is studying wider delivery, but no agent can order a refill for ordinary patients today.

evidence.title: 모든 환자 대상 비대면 진료 '약 배송' 확대 본격 검토

SG.note: HealthHub has a Medication refill service that needs no Singpass login. We found no AI agent that can order a refill for you.

evidence.title: HealthHub

ID.note: Halodoc says its platform works with pharmacies, but we found no AI agent that renews or orders a prescription for you in Indonesia. Our checks did not look at pharmacy apps in depth.

evidence.title: Halodoc perkenalkan AIDA, AI Doctor Assistant untuk memberdayakan layanan kesehatan dan dokter Indonesia

capabilities.name: Check your health cover or a claim
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent check what your own health plan covers, or the status of your claim, for you?

US.note: UnitedHealthcare's Avery, in the UHC app and on myuhc.com since March 2026, answers from your own plan: benefits, coverage, claim status, cost estimates and balances.

evidence.title: UnitedHealthcare Introduces AI Companion Empowering People with Simpler Navigation, Personal Experience

GB.note: NHS care is free at the point of use, and no live AI assistant that checks your cover or a claim was found at Bupa, AXA Health or Vitality; their claims run through ordinary app and web forms.

DE.note: Barmer's chatbot answers general questions and AOK Plus uses AI voice agents to route calls, but none looks up your own cover or files a claim; the TK app lists no AI assistant.

evidence.title: AOK Plus: KI-Agenten automatisieren Kundendienst in EU-Cloud

IN.note: ICICI Lombard launched an AI voice agent in 2022 that tells customers the status of their own health claims, and in August 2026 it said bots and a WhatsApp chatbot answer about 70% of inbound calls, but no recent source says they still give claim status. No other insurer was confirmed.

evidence.title: ICICI Lombard and Skit.ai partner to launch an AI-powered digital voice agent to track claim status
How ICICI Lombard is using AI-driven tech to boost efficiencies

BR.note: A 2018 report says SulAmérica's virtual assistant answers common questions, including about refunds, but no recent source says it checks your own cover or claim; no AI assistant was found for SUS.

evidence.title: SulAmérica adota Inteligência Artificial e reduz em 90% tempo médio de atendimento

MX.note: IMSS shows your coverage in the IMSS Digital app with no AI, and its planned AI assistant is for doctors; no AI tool was found at GNP or AXA Mexico.

evidence.title: El IMSS planea aplicar inteligencia artificial en su expediente clínico electrónico

CL.note: FONASA's Mi Fonasa virtual branch and the Isapres Colmena, Banmédica and Consalud handle refunds and certificates in ordinary apps, with no AI assistant found (searched October 2026).

CO.note: Famisanar's WhatsApp assistant Camila handles your own medical authorizations, but no source says it is AI; nothing was found at Sura, Nueva EPS or ADRES.

evidence.title: Cómo pedir virtualmente autorizaciones, incapacidades y certificaciones en Famisanar

ES.note: We found no live AI assistant at Sanitas, Adeslas or DKV that looks up your own cover or a claim; their apps and WhatsApp channels use ordinary menus and human agents.

FR.note: Alan's AI health companion Mo, live for over 500,000 Alan members in France (May 2026), understands the member's own cover and takes insurance questions through to care. Alan's letter does not say Mo shows claim status, so that part is unconfirmed.

evidence.title: Alan - 2026 Q1 Letter to shareholders (Mo live for 500k+ members in France)

CA.note: Sun Life launched an Alexa skill in 2019 that reads your benefit balances and the status of a recent medical or dental claim, but we found no current page showing it still works. No 2026 member-facing AI that checks cover or claims was found at Manulife, Sun Life or Canada Life.

evidence.title: Sun Life now allows Amazon Alexa to find benefits information for clients

JP.note: Public health insurance covers everyone at a fixed co-pay, and we found no AI assistant at a health insurance society or private insurer that looks up your own cover or a claim; UnitedHealthcare's Avery is US-only.

AU.note: No live AI assistant that checks your own cover or claim status was found at Medibank, Bupa, HCF or nib; Medibank's FY26 results do not mention one.

evidence.title: FY26 Results Media Release

NG.note: AXA Mansard Health's WhatsApp bot Karis (March 2026) lets enrollees check plan benefits and confirm treatment authorisations, but no source says it is AI, so the cell stays none, as for similar bots elsewhere.

evidence.title: AXA Mansard Health Introduces WhatsApp ChatBot 'Karis' To Streamline Healthcare Access Across Nigeria

KR.note: I found no AI agent that checks your own health cover or a claim status in Korea. I did not check each insurer's app in depth, so this is a thin result.

SG.note: We found no Singapore insurer with an AI assistant that checks your own health cover or claim status. The insurer AI tools we found serve agents or staff, or give general answers.

ID.note: We found no AI agent that checks your own health cover or claim status in Indonesia, for BPJS Kesehatan or for private insurers. Our checks did not look at each insurer's chat channel, so this is a low-confidence none.
